-- forever-route-lab RXP parser fixture 06: lowering to route groups and steps, and export.
-- Self-authored (GPL-3.0-or-later). Quest, NPC and item IDs and the Gornek, Hawkwind and
-- Hana'zua positions come from QuestieDB data/Forever at b6f5b07 (see fixture 01; Chief Hawkwind
-- is foreverNpcDB.lua:2448). Quest 900001 is synthetic and is not in the dataset. 6673 is a real
-- spell ID used only as a syntax example. All other coordinates are placeholders.
-- Each RXP step is tagged Lnn. docs/RXP.md section 19.3 lists the expected groups, steps and
-- diagnostics for every Lnn, and the export cases X1-X5 that use this file.
#forever
#name 13-14 Lowering Fixture
#version 1
#group Forever Route Lab Fixtures
#subgroup Parser Samples

step
    -- L01: Gornek's position in world form: UiMap 1411 on world map 1, HereBeDragons order (world
    -- Y, then world X). It must resolve to Durotar 42.06,68.33 (docs/research/coordinates.md 7).
    .goto 1411/1,-4186.42,-600.30
    .turnin -788 >> Hand in Cutting Teeth if it is in your log
    .accept 789
step
    -- L02: percent points on frame-changed UiMaps: Mulgore by name and by number, and the
    -- StormwindClassic pseudo-zone (UiMap 1453). Each gets RXP030; the import option picks the frame.
    .goto Mulgore,43.89,76.66,0
    .goto 1412,44.00,77.00,0
    .goto StormwindClassic,60.00,70.00
    >> Three frame-ambiguous points
step
    -- L03: RXP converts StormwindNew with coefficients this project does not have (RXP036).
    .goto StormwindNew,50.00,50.00
    >> An unconvertible pseudo-zone point
step
    -- L04: waypoint kinds, a filtered goto after the location, and merged .complete lines.
    .goto Durotar,45.00,70.00,35,0
    .goto Durotar,46.00,68.00,35,0
    .goto Durotar,45.50,69.00,0
    .goto Durotar,44.00,69.00,20
    .goto Durotar,44.20,69.20 << Orc
    .complete 788,1
    .complete 789,1
    .complete 788,2 --RXP031: quest 788 has one objective
    .mob Mottled Boar
step
    #completewith next
    -- L05: every quest target in a #completewith step is partial.
    .complete 792,1
    .collect 4862,10,789,1
    .complete 900001,1 --RXP032: quest 900001 is not in the dataset
step
    -- L06: any-of accept and a turn-in with a reward choice.
    .goto Durotar,42.06,68.33
    .acceptmultiple 790,792 >> Take whichever of the two is offered
    .turnin 789,2
step
    -- L07: grind targets: plain level, xpInto (L+N), xpShort (L-N) and fraction (L.F) offsets.
    .xp 6
    .xp 6+150
    .xp 7-200
    .xp 7.5
step << Orc/Troll
    -- L08: group-level condition: step filter, variant tags and a skip predicate.
    #xprate <1.5
    #softcore
    .dungeon RFC
    .isOnQuest 790
    .goto Durotar,40.60,62.58
    .turnin 790
step
    -- L09: travel, bind, flight and hearth steps.
    .goto Durotar,52.00,41.00,15
    >> Walk to the placeholder point
step
    .goto Durotar,51.90,41.60
    .home >> Bind the Hearthstone here
step
    .goto Durotar,45.50,12.50
    .fp Orgrimmar >> Discover this flight master
    .fly Crossroads >> Then fly on
step
    .hs >> Use the Hearthstone
step
    -- L10: a trainer visit, a spell, a death skip the route model does not simulate (RXP034)
    -- and an any-of turn-in.
    .trainer
    .train 6673 >> Learn spell 6673
    .deathskip >> Kept as a preserved note
    .turninmultiple 790,792 >> Hand in whichever of the two you have
